native.ps_edition: Actual PubSub mapping edition; distinct current Client/Server Part4/6 edition.
native.ps_binding: Actual transport selection; no physical Ethernet/IP/UDP imposed by application label.
native.ps_encoding: Actual message mapping, UADP binary or JSON; not inferred from bearer.
native.ps_role: Actual Publisher or Subscriber; identities/addresses have different scope.
native.ps_dataset_kind: Actual cyclic data, acyclic events, or heartbeat, with distinct key-frame rules.
native.ps_publisher_type: Actual configured PublisherId type; integers preserved as decimal text, JSON identifier rendered as text.
native.ps_assignment: Actual WriterGroupId external versus internal allocator range.
native.ps_dataset_assignment: Actual DataSetWriterId allocator, independent WriterGroupId allocator.
native.ps_delivery: Actual RequestedDeliveryGuarantee; broker QoS does not prove functional processing.
native.ps_ordering: Actual DataSetOrdering, default Undefined does not imply fixed layout.
native.ps_network_mode: Actual UDP addressing mode; DTLS allows only unicast.
native.ps_ip_version: Actual network IP version, absent on direct Ethernet.
native.ps_budget_layer: Actual layer defining MTU budget; IP packet differs whole Ethernet frame or broker packet.
native.ps_mqtt_version: Configured MQTT version selection versus actual negotiated version.
native.ps_mqtt_actual_version: Actual broker connection MQTT version, not automatically BestAvailable.
native.ps_topic_kind: Actual standard topic message class, with class-dependent RETAIN.
native.ps_security_mode: Actual NetworkMessage security mode, separate DTLS/TLS and key-service authorization.
native.ps_sequence_phase: Actual first/new transmit sequence or receiver comparison, not UASC chunk token sequence.
native.ps_sequence_result: Actual receiver freshness classification under modular half-range rules.
native.ps_outcome: Actual data/action outcome, separate metadata/transport validity.
native.ps_profile_uri: Actual TransportProfileUri selects both transport and message mapping.
native.ps_address: Actual configured transport address, not a generic default multicast or localhost destination.
native.ps_writer_address: Actual WriterGroup UDP unicast send address; must be absent for multicast/broadcast.
native.ps_interface: Actual network interface; required for multicast/broadcast when multiple interfaces exist.
native.ps_publisher_id: Actual PublisherId, nonzero unsigned integer as lossless decimal text or nonempty string.
native.ps_publisher_filter: Actual expected PublisherId for received-message filtering, not source IP alone.
native.ps_metadata_source: Actual DataSetMetaData/field types/configuration version and reader agreement.
native.ps_profile_source: Actual edition, transport profile, address/identity and mapping source.
native.ps_peer_source: Actual Publisher/Subscriber/broker implementation limits and capabilities.
native.ps_physical_source: Actual chosen bearer, MTU/header overhead/topology and link-service evidence.
native.ps_security_source: Actual message/transport/key-service policy and trust evidence; not tokens or secret keys.
native.ps_acceptance_source: Actual correlated dataset/action result, status and source-age acceptance.
native.ps_registered_source: Actual separately registered transport, including informative AMQP mapping when selected.
native.ps_topic_prefix: Actual MQTT topic convention prefix; literature proposal opcua.
native.ps_topic: Actual publish topic, not subscription wildcard filter.
native.ps_content_type: Actual MQTT5 content type identifies binary UADP versus JSON.
native.ps_security_group_id: Actual SecurityGroup scope for non-None message security.
native.ps_flags1_hex: Actual UADP DataSetFlags1 byte as hex, decoded field encoding/validity/sequence presence.
native.ps_publish_offsets_ms_json: Actual ordered PublishingOffset array in milliseconds as JSON numbers; negative values mark not configured, not zero-latency proof.
native.ps_writer_group_id: Actual UInt16 WriterGroupId, zero is null not an assigned group.
native.ps_dataset_writer_id: Actual UInt16 DataSetWriterId, explicit metadata identity.
native.ps_keyframe_count: Cyclic keyframe multiplier>=1, acyclic0, heartbeat1; not CAN retry count.
native.ps_publish_ms: Actual PublishingInterval,0 only when every writer is acyclic/keyframe0; no universal100ms.
native.ps_keepalive_ms: Actual keepalive interval, strictly positive and at least PublishingInterval.
native.ps_receive_timeout_ms: Actual maximum time between new DataSetMessages; heartbeat/keepalive reset as defined, not request timeoutHint.
native.ps_priority: Actual WriterGroup relative priority Byte, not VLAN PCP.
native.ps_max_network_bytes: Actual MaxNetworkMessageSize includes padding/signature, excludes added bearer headers.
native.ps_network_bytes: Actual complete encoded NetworkMessage including security/padding; not application object bytes.
native.ps_headers_bytes: Actual bearer added headers/FCS under selected transport; not always Ethernet22+IPv420+UDP8.
native.ps_wire_bytes: Actual NetworkMessage plus selected bearer overhead, no physical baud inferred.
native.ps_path_mtu: Actual path MTU at the explicitly declared layer, not inherited CAN payload or unconditional1500.
native.ps_ip_header_bytes: Actual IP header bytes incl selected options/extensions, distinct MAC/FCS/UDP.
native.ps_ip_packet_bytes: Actual whole IP packet=NetworkMessage+IPheader+UDP8; excludes Ethernet/FCS.
native.ps_transport_overhead_bytes: Actual DTLS record/header/tag/padding bytes between UA message and UDP; plainUDP has zero.
native.ps_port: Actual UDP/DTLS destination port; source proposals4840/4843, other ports allowed.
native.ps_discovery_max_bytes: Actual DiscoveryMaxMessageSize, transport-specific proposal4096 only UDP.
native.ps_discovery_announce_s: Actual datagram discovery announcement period seconds; source default0 probe-response-only.
native.ps_repeat_count: Actual datagram MessageRepeatCount Byte; source default0 disables repeat, not retry-limitCAN.
native.ps_repeat_delay_ms: Actual delay between datagram repeats; ignored when repeat_count0.
native.ps_sampling_offset_ms: Actual UADP creation offset within publish cycle; any negative means unspecified.
native.ps_receive_offset_ms: Actual UADP expected receive offset, negative means unspecified; not measured delay.
native.ps_processing_offset_ms: Actual UADP application processing offset, negative means unspecified.
native.ps_publish_offsets_count: Actual count of the ordered publishing-offset array; no invented offset per packet.
native.ps_uadp_version: Actual four-bit UADP NetworkMessage version; current mapping version1.
native.ps_ether_type: Actual direct Ethernet UADP EtherType0xB62C, not IPv4/UDP framing.
native.ps_vlan: Actual direct Ethernet VID where explicitly configured, not generic application parameter.
native.ps_pcp: Actual direct Ethernet Priority Code Point, distinct WriterGroup priority.
native.ps_interface_count: Actual available network interfaces for multicast interface selection.
native.ps_dtls_version: Actual DTLS version for selected transport; current mapping requires1.3.
native.ps_mqtt_qos: Actual MQTT publish/subscribe QoS mapping for delivery guarantee.
native.ps_mqtt_keepalive_s: Actual connection Keep Alive separate per-writer keepalive milliseconds.
native.ps_max_group_keepalive_ms: Actual maximum KeepAliveTime across writers on broker connection.
native.ps_broker_packet_limit: Actual negotiated broker/device complete MQTT packet limit, not PubSub payload65507.
native.ps_mqtt_packet_bytes: Actual encoded MQTT packet with all headers/properties/topic and UA payload.
native.ps_configured_dataset_bytes: Actual UADP ConfiguredSize,0 dynamic; undersize marks dataset invalid rather than silent truncation.
native.ps_dataset_bytes: Actual encoded DataSetMessage excluding zero padding; no universal scalar payload limit.
native.ps_dataset_padded_bytes: Actual occupied size including configured zero padding.
native.ps_network_message_number: Actual UADP message ordinal,0 dynamic; fixed one-message layout requires1.
native.ps_dataset_offset: Actual UADP byte position from NetworkMessage start;0 dynamic.
native.ps_network_messages_per_interval: Actual messages generated by group per interval, at most65535.
native.ps_version_major: Actual DataSet configuration major version, zero for heartbeat.
native.ps_version_minor: Actual DataSet configuration minor version, zero for heartbeat.
native.ps_sequence_width: Actual sequence-header width16 or32, selected by encoding/header context.
native.ps_sequence: Actual UInt16/UADP or UInt32/JSON sequence, exact wrap arithmetic.
native.ps_previous_sequence: Actual last sent or last processed sequence for same writer/group context.
native.ps_sequence_distance: Exact(new-1-last) modulo2^N, not raw subtraction or UASC lifetime rule.
native.ps_age_ms: Actual accepted source data age, distinct receive-timeout/network latency.
native.ps_freshness_limit_ms: Actual application accepted data-age limit, no universal PubSub standard.
native.ps_no_ip_fragmentation: Explicit chosen requirement to fit NetworkMessage and IP/UDP headers in actual IP MTU.
native.ps_membership_reported: Actual receiver IGMP/MLD membership setup for UDP multicast.
native.ps_metadata_matches: Actual received metadata/version/type compatibility, not a missing-header guess.
native.ps_dataset_valid: Actual DataSet valid flag; oversized fixed ConfiguredSize invalidates message.
native.ps_sequence_present: Actual sequence enabled; absence is not sequence0 and changes new-message detection.
native.ps_retain: Actual MQTT RETAIN class-specific; data override requires explicit property.
native.ps_data_retain_override: Actual configured data RETAIN override, not metadata/default inference.
native.ps_tls: Actual MQTT TLS connection state, separate end-to-end UADP message security.
native.ps_data_accepted: Actual application consumption/action accepted, not merely authenticated delivery.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application byte count distinct DataSet/NetworkMessage/metadata/security/padding/bearer/MQTT packet. No universal8byte payload or65507byte UDP ceiling on all mappings.
